roof_diagnosis.cause: Top-heavy studio lighting and dielectric highlights, not missing roof paint. All faces used the baked olive material.
roof_diagnosis.correction: Shared world-space olive paint on every surface; specular IOR level 0.10; lower studio light elevations and weaker rim.

junction_diagnosis.definition: Depth relative to the local lower head face extrapolated down at dy/dz=0.13. Opening measured where depth exceeds 1 mm, restricted to the connected deck joint below z=0.70 m. Front rays use 1 mm vertical pitch. Above-front rays point (0,1,-0.8).
